basis: All eleven review counterexamples were reproduced against this branch's owner BEFORE repair; all eleven reproduced exactly.

RVW-001: a duplicate source row is refused before the canonicalizing dict can overwrite one, unconditionally on whether the targets agree. With differing targets the reproduction showed a caller could substitute the owner's replacement successor and have it enter the receipt identity.

RVW-002: the serialized negative row must STATE replacement_ref and it must be exactly null; a missing field is no longer treated as a stated null and a forged non-null value is no longer silently discarded.

RVW-002: from_dict now enforces a mutual-exclusivity compatibility boundary. Declaring the new schema requires the exact schema id AND at least one row; anything else is legacy positive-only material, which still reproduces its historical identity byte for byte.

RVW-003: a dependent absent from the owner's own known_dependent_refs now resolves to the typed NOT_GOVERNED state and raises the typed OwnerUnknownDependent failure. Absence of a recorded transition is absence of authority, not evidence of currentness.
RVW-003: currentness is never inferred from cache or object presence; the gate reads only the graph's declared dependent set.
RVW-004: replay now independently recomputes BOTH A and U and requires exact equality with both serialized sets, so A and U are disjoint and cover K at replay and not merely at initial production.
RVW-003 and RVW-004 are interdependent and were closed together; either alone leaves a live path.
The embedded record_ref validation is retained everywhere and is explicitly not treated as sufficient on its own.
No semantic design was reopened and nothing was broadened. No existing court was deleted or rewritten.
The prior 144 remains valid and passing; 16 hostiles added for 160 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped.
next_required_action: Narrow independent rereview of the four C1-03R fail-closed findings. Two readings should be confirmed explicitly: (a) whether treating a known-but-never-transitioned dependent as CURRENT is the intended reading of the approval law, or whether it too should be NOT_GOVERNED; and (b) whether refusing a receipt that declares the new schema with zero noncurrent rows is the intended strict reading of the compatibility boundary, rather than normalizing it.
